title: Villagers boycott panchayat elections in Bharatpur and Deeg over delimitation

tea.why: Villagers protested against delimitation, alleging it was carried out under political pressure and included areas in different village panchayats.
tea.want: To reverse or address delimitation changes that shifted their areas into different village panchayats.
tea.changed: Nov 3, 2026: Villagers in Bharatpur and Deeg districts boycotted voting during the third phase of panchayat elections.

summary: During the third phase of panchayat elections in Rajasthan on November 3, 2026, residents in specific areas of Bharatpur and Deeg districts staged a boycott of polling stations. According to news reports, the villagers withheld their votes in protest against local delimitation changes, which they alleged were conducted under political pressure and incorrectly assigned their regions to different village panchayats. The third phase of the rural polls proceeded across 27 districts amidst these localized boycotts and other incidents. No official response or countermeasures regarding the boycott were detailed in the sources.
demands: Revert changes assigning areas to different village panchayats
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Villagers in Nagla Singhara (Bharatpur) and Nagla Kishore Singh (Deeg) boycotted panchayat polls over delimitation issues.
